final.x_2215032_ai_inc_0_ai_suggestion:
1. Ask the user to browse to the server path directly to verify if the share and permissions are functional. [KB0003 v2.0 §Resolution]
2. If the path opens, re-run the mapping script or remap the drive with reconnect-at-sign-in enabled. [KB0003 v2.0 §Resolution]
3. If the path is refused, check the user's group membership against the share's access group. [KB0003 v2.0 §Resolution]
4. If group membership is missing, raise an access request without modifying the group membership from this incident. [KB0003 v2.0 §Resolution]
5. Confirm the drive is present after a fresh sign-in. [KB0003 v2.0 §Resolution]

Sources: KB0003 v2.0 — MAPPED SHARED DRIVE IS MISSING AFTER SIGN-IN
